_comment: Copy to tenant.json and fill in. The copy is gitignored, and `yarn ensure-tenant`
makes it for you — it runs before start, ios and android, so there is nothing to
None of these are secrets. A public client application has no client secret, and both
GUIDs appear in the sign-in URLs any user of the app can see. They are gitignored
because a repository should not hand out one organisation's tenant as if it were a
default, not because they need protecting.
Where to get them: entra.microsoft.com -> App registrations -> your app -> Overview.
docs/tenant-setup.md walks through creating the registration from nothing.
_redirectUri: Optional. Leave these out and the app derives them from its own bundle id and
package name, which is what Entra generates for the platform entries.
The Android form ends in the SHA-1 of the signing key, percent-encoded. The value
below is for the debug keystore React Native's template ships at
example/android/app/debug.keystore — the same file for everyone, so it needs no
editing unless you sign with your own key. Recompute with:
_testUpn: Optional convenience: prefills the sign-in field on the example's screen so you are
not retyping an address on a phone keyboard. Nothing reads it in the module.
